short.en: Which layer you are on each day

t.zh: 你知道一只股票接下来每天的价格。只能买一次、卖一次，先买后卖，最多能赚多少？
t.en: You know a stock’s price on each of the coming days. You may buy once and sell once, buying first. How much can you make at most?

t.zh: 每天结束时，你处在三种状态之一：还没买、手里有股、卖掉了。每种状态一层，一天一列。
t.en: At the end of each day you are in one of three states: not bought yet, holding, or sold. Each state is a layer, with a column for each day.

t.zh: 每一层都跑同一块电路板。左边一格是前一天的同一层；探针读来处那层的前一天。从来处走到这一层的进账写在「本格信息」里：买入要付今天的价，卖出能得今天的价。
t.en: Every layer runs the same board. The cell to the left is the same layer the day before; the probe reads the layer you come from, the day before. What stepping over from there brings in is in the This cell panel: buying pays today’s price, selling earns it.

goal.zh: 算出最多能赚多少钱。一次也不买也行，那就是 0。
goal.en: Work out the most money you can make. Not trading at all is allowed, which makes 0.

how.zh: 答案是最后一天「还没买」和「卖掉了」两层里较大的那个。
how.en: The answer is the larger of the “not bought yet” and “sold” layers on the last day.

say.zh: 买和卖都是换一层：探针读来处那层的前一天。
say.en: Buying and selling both change layer: the probe reads the layer you come from, the day before.

hints.zh: 维持原样，还是从来处走过来？取较大。
hints.en: Stay as you were, or step over from where you come from? Take the larger.

hints.zh: 从来处走过来 = 探针读到的 + 这一步的进账。
hints.en: Stepping over = what the probe reads + what the step brings in.

body.zh: 每一层存「到今天为止、今天处在这种状态，最多有多少钱」。买卖只是从一层走到另一层。
body.en: Each layer holds “the most money you can have today, ending today in this state”. Buying and selling just move you from one layer to another.
